attributes.name: Mistress Delvahine
attributes.powers:
Mistress Delvahine is immune to the Electricity, Fire, and Poison traits.

Succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check or you may not play spells with the Attack trait.

Before the encounter, succeed at a Wisdom 12 check or a random character at your location takes Combat damage equal to the number of spells with the Attack trait and weapons in your hand.

If undefeated, Delvahine does not deal damage. Instead, bury a random blessing from your hand, or bury your entire hand if you have no blessings.
